sounds.title: Sound library
sounds.intro: SoundFonts (.sf2, .sf3) and sound effects (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, M4A) in folders. The audio files of a folder become one instrument in MuseScore, named after the folder: the first sound is on C4, each next one a semitone higher. In the mixer, set a staff’s sound to it and write notes on those keys.
sounds.scope.shared.hint: For everyone who uses MuseScore in MiniNode.

plugins.title: Plugins for everyone
plugins.intro: Plugins here are stored in MiniNode and available to everyone who uses MuseScore. New plugins start disabled: enable them in MuseScore under Home → Plugins. After adding one, choose “Reload plugins” there. Plugins are programs: only add ones you trust.
plugins.added: “{name}” is available to everyone. In MuseScore, choose “Reload plugins” on the Plugins page and enable it.
plugins.removed: “{name}” is removed. Others lose it after their next reload.
plugins.empty: No plugins yet. Add a .qml file or a zipped plugin folder.
plugins.invalid: It contains no .qml file; a MuseScore plugin needs one.
plugins.prompt.title: AI prompt: adapt a plugin for the browser
plugins.prompt.intro: A plugin does not run here (it was made for older MuseScore versions or calls programs on the computer)? Copy this prompt into any AI tool, attach the plugin’s files and add the result here.
data.title: Your MuseScore data
data.intro: Export saves your scores from MiniNode and your MuseScore settings (workspaces, palettes, plugins) as one ZIP file. Import brings such a file back, on this or another device; scores with the same name are replaced.

data.empty: This file contains no MuseScore data from MiniNode.
data.notZip: This is not a ZIP file.
data.unsupported: “{name}” is packed in a way that cannot be read.

scores.title: Scores in MiniNode
scores.intro: Every save to MiniNode keeps the last 20 versions of a score; restore one as a file of its own. “Share” puts a copy there for everyone who uses MuseScore here.
scores.noVersions: No earlier versions yet (they are kept from now on when you save).
